A '''[[Planet/Legends|planet]]''' in the [[Gelviddis Cluster/Legends|Gelviddis Cluster]] had sand with a unique property. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] discovered this sand would [[Sand levitation|assume the shape]] of whatever an observer was thinking.
